runners.name: Aegis
runners.title: Lenore
runners.text: When a friendly Runner directly beside Aegis (same row, neighboring lane) is attacked, Aegis may take the attack instead and hit back.

runners.name: Waypoint
runners.title: Wren
runners.text: Instead of attacking, choose a face-down enemy trap within 2 squares ahead in Waypoint's lane. Discard it without triggering it, or flip it face-up if a Runner is on it.
runners.flavor: “Every path through the rift has a trap on it. I just find it first.”

runners.name: Tinder
runners.title: Kestrel
runners.pattern: Any square in the next row ahead: directly in front or diagonally ahead on either side
runners.text: When Tinder attacks, he may add +3 damage. If he does, the target does not hit back, and Tinder takes 2 damage after the attack.
runners.flavor: “You got the brains. I got the fire.”

runners.name: Zenith
runners.title: Solenne
runners.pattern: Any square 2 to 3 ahead in her lane. Ignores Blockers on the square 2 ahead.
runners.text: Instead of attacking, choose up to 2 enemy Runners ahead of Zenith in her lane. Each takes 2 damage. The closest one hits back.

runners.name: Lumen
runners.title: Dr. Elias Marsh
runners.text: Instead of attacking, restore 1 Health to a friendly Runner next to Lumen. If it is Powered, also remove a trap effect from it (Stunned or Double Damage). Can't target the same Runner on back-to-back turns.

runners.name: Blink
runners.title: Indira
runners.text: Instead of attacking normally, Blink attacks the same target twice, each hit dealing 3 damage. The target hits back after each attack.

runners.name: Anvil
runners.title: Gunnar
runners.pattern: 1 or 2 squares ahead in his lane
runners.text: Instead of attacking, stun each enemy in the next row ahead: the square directly in front of him and the squares diagonally ahead on each side. Lasts one round.
runners.flavor: “I don't need to hit you. I need you to stay down.”

runners.name: Lockstep
runners.title: Rook
runners.text: Plating 2 against the first attack from a Powered Runner each turn (that attack deals 2 less damage).
runners.flavor: “She kept us safe for years. Now it's our turn.”

runners.name: Gremlin
runners.title: Silas Morrow
runners.text: Instead of attacking, place a Trap from your hand face-down on an empty square next to Gremlin (any direction), even outside your half.
runners.flavor: “I've been building the end of the world for fifty years. I'm getting good at it.”

runners.name: Hornet
runners.title: Mara Voss
runners.pattern: Exactly 2 rows ahead, in her lane or a neighboring lane. Ignores Blockers.
runners.text: When Hornet attacks, the target doesn't hit back.
runners.flavor: “You won't see me coming. You'll hear the drone.”

runners.name: Faedra
runners.title: Faedra
runners.text: Other friendly Runners in her row get +1 ATK.

extra.text: Instead of attacking, return a Runner from your discard pile to an empty back-row square. All friendly Runners restore 1 Health. Faedra is stunned until next turn.

runners.flavor: “I've watched a hundred worlds burn. Not this one.”

runners.name: Herald
runners.title: Callum Reed
runners.text: Recon 3. Put 1 of those cards in your hand. The rest go to the bottom of the deck in any order.

runners.name: Arc
runners.title: Lance Springs
runners.text: This turn his attack also hits the enemy on the next square past the target, in the same lane. That Runner doesn't hit back.

runners.name: Aria
runners.title: Tayjah Williams
runners.text: This turn she can attack any square in the next row ahead: directly in front or diagonally ahead on either side.

extra.text: This turn she hits every enemy in the next row ahead (directly in front and both diagonals). Only the one directly in front hits back. Then she's stunned until the end of your next turn.

runners.flavor: “Save the high note for the finale.”

runners.name: Cadence
runners.title: Billy Thorpe
runners.text: When Cadence moves forward while beside a friendly Runner, that Runner may also move forward 1. Free: it doesn't count toward your 2 moves. Traps still stop it.

runners.name: Vault
runners.title: Kennedy Jones
runners.text: When Vault ends a move in the enemy half (rows 4 to 6), Draw 1.

runners.name: Bastion
runners.title: Buck Dudley
runners.text: Friendly Runners beside Bastion get +2 Lethal on every step that has one. Not himself, and two Bastions still give only +2.

runners.name: Spyglass
runners.title: Iris Casey
runners.text: Recon 3. Put any number of those cards on the bottom of the deck. Put the rest back on top in any order.
runners.flavor: “Rock tells you what already happened. My eye tells me what's next.”

runners.name: Leviathan
runners.title: Leviathan
runners.text: Attacks on it deal 1 less damage.

extra.text: Instead of attacking, deploy a Runner costing 4 or less from your hand for free onto an empty square in your half, in its lane or a neighboring lane. Counts as your deploy.
Can't attack the turn it's deployed.

runners.name: Vantage
runners.title: Beau Hale
runners.text: Friendly Drones in neighboring lanes (any row) get +1 ATK.

extra.text: Instead of attacking, flip a face-down enemy trap up to 3 rows ahead, in Vantage's lane or a neighboring lane, face up. It still triggers. Once per game, Scramble it: it no longer stops movement or stuns.

runners.name: Tripwire
runners.title: Talia Ramirez
runners.text: When an enemy Runner activates one of your traps, draw a card.
runners.flavor: “Every one you step on teaches me something.”

runners.name: Sleight
runners.title: Juno Voleur
runners.text: Instead of attacking an enemy in range, your opponent discards the top card of their deck. If any enemy Runner is on or next to one of your traps, they reveal their top 2 instead: you discard one, and the other goes back on top.

runners.name: Payload
runners.title: Sal Moretti
runners.text: When an enemy Runner activates one of your traps, that Runner also takes 2 damage (no hit-back).

extra.text: When Payload is defeated, you may place a Trap from hand face-down on his square for free, even outside your half.

runners.name: Breaker
runners.title: Greta Kurz
runners.text: Attacks on her deal 1 less damage.

extra.text: +1 ATK in the enemy half (rows 4 to 6).
Traps she activates don't stop her movement. Their other effects still apply.

runners.name: Hangar
runners.title: Dmitri Volkov
runners.text: Instead of attacking, deploy a Drone costing 2 or less from hand for free onto an empty square next to Hangar (any direction), in your half. Counts as your deploy.

runners.name: Drone Pilot
runners.title: Generic
runners.pattern: Exactly 2 rows ahead in its lane. Ignores Blockers.
runners.text: +1 ATK while you have a Carrier on the board.

runners.name: Swarm Drone
runners.title: Generic
runners.text: +1 ATK while you have a Carrier on the board.

runners.name: Hammerhead
runners.title: Rufus Okafor
runners.text: Attacks on him deal 1 less damage.

extra.text: When Hammerhead attacks and the target survives, push it back 1 square in its lane after it hits back. If that square is occupied, it stays put. Being pushed doesn't activate traps.

runners.name: Trailblazer
runners.title: Mateo Reyes
runners.text: When Trailblazer ends a move in the enemy half (rows 4 to 6), Draw 1. Then each other friendly Runner in his lane may move forward 1. Free: it doesn't count toward your 2 moves. Traps still stop it.
runners.flavor: “Keep up. The path closes behind us.”

runners.name: Flashpoint
runners.title: Priya Nair
runners.text: This turn, if her attack doesn't defeat the target, the target is stunned until the end of its owner's next turn (it can't attack or hit back).

runners.name: Mortar
runners.title: Erik Halvorsen
runners.pattern: Exactly 2 rows ahead in its lane. Ignores Blockers.
runners.text: At the end of your turn, if Mortar didn't move this turn, it becomes Entrenched (mark it with a coin): +1 ATK and Plating 1 (attacks on it deal 1 less damage). Moving or being pushed ends Entrenched.
runners.flavor: “HA HA! Dig in. Let it rain.”

runners.name: Spire
runners.title: Hana Sato
runners.pattern: 1 or 2 rows ahead in her lane
runners.text: This turn her attack ignores Plating, and the target doesn't hit back.
runners.flavor: “Armor is just a promise. I break promises.”

runners.name: Hook
runners.title: Cass Duffy
runners.text: Instead of attacking, pull an enemy Runner 2 or 3 squares ahead in Hook's lane 1 square toward Hook. If that square is occupied, it stays put. If it's pulled onto one of your traps, the trap activates.
runners.flavor: “Come here. I set a place for you.”

runners.name: Sapper
runners.title: Yusuf Demir
runners.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Place up to 2 Traps from among them face-down on empty squares in your half, for free. Put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order.
runners.flavor: “One wrong step. That's all it takes.”

runners.name: Riposte
runners.title: Rosa Delgado
runners.text: When an enemy attacks a friendly Runner beside Riposte (same row, neighboring lane), after the attack she deals 2 damage to that enemy. It's an effect: it ignores Plating and can't be hit back.
runners.flavor: “You swing at them, you answer to me.”

runners.name: Tailwind
runners.title: Makani Kūpaʻa
runners.text: Friendly Runners that start their move beside Tailwind (same row, neighboring lane) get +1 MOV for that move. Tailwind doesn't boost herself.

runners.name: Relay Drone
runners.title: Generic
runners.text: +1 ATK while you have a Carrier on the board.

extra.text: If another friendly Drone is in a neighboring lane, Draw 1.

runners.name: Scrapper
runners.title: Pip Alvarez
runners.text: When a friendly Drone is defeated, Draw 1.
runners.flavor: “Broke it? Good. Now I've got parts.”

runners.name: Swarmcaller
runners.title: Oren Feld
runners.text: Recon 4. Put any Drones among those cards in your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order.

runners.name: Warden
runners.title: Gus Ferreira
runners.text: Enemy Runners in the lanes on either side of Warden can't move past his row. One that reaches his row stops there and loses any movement it has left. This isn't a trap, so it stops Breaker too.

runners.name: Shield Recruit
runners.title: Generic
runners.text: While beside another friendly Runner (same row, neighboring lane), Shield Recruit has +2 Lethal on every step that has one.
runners.flavor: “Shoulder to shoulder. Just like they taught us.”

runners.name: Stalwart Recruit
runners.title: Generic
runners.text: When a friendly Runner beside Stalwart Recruit (same row, neighboring lane) would be defeated, you may defeat Stalwart Recruit instead. The other Runner takes no damage from that hit or effect.

runners.name: Conduit
runners.title: Jonah Whitfield
runners.text: Another friendly Runner in Conduit's row gets +1 ATK this turn.
runners.flavor: “Take what you need. I've got plenty.”

runners.name: Spool
runners.title: Dee Kowalski
runners.text: When an enemy Runner activates one of your traps, return that trap to your hand instead of the discard pile. A lasting trap returns when its duration ends.

runners.name: Avenger
runners.title: Ren Takeda
runners.pattern: Any square in the next row ahead: directly in front or diagonally ahead on either side
runners.text: When a friendly Runner next to Avenger (any direction) is defeated, he gets +2 ATK until the end of your next turn and restores 1 Health.

runners.name: Ember
runners.title: Nadia Haddad
runners.text: Restore 1 Health to a friendly Runner next to Ember (any direction).

runners.name: Geode
runners.title: Hollis Grant
runners.text: When Geode ends a move in the enemy half (rows 4 to 6), look at every face-down enemy trap in his lane.

runners.name: Raider
runners.title: Zara Quinn
runners.text: While Raider is in the enemy half (rows 4 to 6), targets of her attacks don't hit back.
runners.flavor: “By the time you turn around, I'm gone.”

runners.name: Welder
runners.title: Ines Carvalho
runners.text: Instead of attacking, restore 1 Health to a friendly Runner that has Plating (any source) next to Welder (any direction).

runners.name: Ballast
runners.title: Bram de Vries
runners.text: Attacks on him deal 1 less damage.

runners.name: Rampart
runners.title: Kofi Mensah
runners.text: The friendly Runner directly behind Rampart (same lane, one row back) has Plating 1 (attacks on it deal 1 less damage). It stacks with any Plating it already has.

runners.name: Cutter
runners.title: Dax Mercer
runners.text: Instead of moving, choose a square next to Cutter (any direction). If an enemy trap is there, look at it. It becomes yours and stays face-down (mark it with a coin). When it leaves the board, it goes to its owner's discard pile.

runners.name: Pilfer
runners.title: Kit Calloway
runners.text: Instead of attacking, discard an Upgrade attached to an enemy Runner that Pilfer's attack could reach.

runners.name: Sellsword
runners.title: Corin Ashby
runners.text: +1 ATK while no other friendly Runner is in Sellsword's lane.

runners.name: Bounty Hunter
runners.title: Vesna Kral
runners.text: Choose an enemy Runner and mark it with a coin. While Bounty Hunter is on the board, when that Runner is defeated (by any means), Draw 2 and remove the mark.

runners.name: The Wanderer
runners.title: Unknown
runners.text: Move to any empty square in his row, any lane. Not one of your 2 moves; he can still move. A trap there still goes off.

extra.text: If he Rift Walked this turn, his attack can't be hit back, and the target is stunned until the end of its owner's next turn.

runners.flavor: “Every road ends somewhere. I've seen most of them.”

supports.name: Ambush Alarm
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner takes double damage from all sources.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Suppression Mine
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner is stunned: it can't attack or hit back.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Frag Mine
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner takes 2 damage.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Repulsor Plate
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: Push the triggering Runner back 1 square in its lane, toward its own side. If that square is occupied, it stays put. Being pushed doesn't activate traps.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: EMP Spike
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: Discard the triggering Runner's upgrade.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Drain Spike
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner's owner gets 1 less Halcyte on their next turn.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Decoy
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: No effect on the Runner (it still stops). You draw a card.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Snare
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner can't move on its owner's next turn. It can still attack.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Rift Tear
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: Return the triggering Runner to its owner's hand. Discard its upgrade.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Halcyte Leak
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner and every enemy Runner beside it (same row) can't move on their owner's next turn. They can still attack.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Sanctuary Glyph
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: Your Runners next to this square (any direction) restore 1 Health.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Mirror Ward
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner takes damage equal to its current ATK.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Stasis Cage
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner can't move, attack or hit back.
supports.duration: Until the end of its owner's next turn
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Claymore
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner takes 3 damage.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Overload Coil
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: The triggering Runner takes 3 damage if it is Powered, or 1 if it is Tech.
supports.howto: Place face-down on an empty square in your half. Discard after it triggers.

supports.name: Blast Barricade
supports.title: Trap
supports.text: Push the triggering Runner back 1 square in its lane. No Runner can enter this square while the barricade stands.
supports.duration: Until the end of your next turn
supports.howto: Place face-down in your half. After it activates it stays face-up, then discard it when the duration ends.

supports.name: Hero's Sacrifice
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: When a friendly Runner would be defeated, it stays on the board on its last step instead. Its upgrade stays attached.
supports.howto: Play it the moment its trigger happens, on either player's turn. Then discard it.

supports.name: Shield Wall
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: When an enemy attacks a friendly Runner that's beside another friendly Runner: until end of turn, the target and every friendly Runner beside it get +2 Lethal on every step that has one.
supports.howto: Play it the moment its trigger happens, on either player's turn. Then discard it.

supports.name: Breakaway
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: A friendly Runner moves forward 2 squares (free: it doesn't count toward your 2 moves). It can't enter the enemy back row. If it ends in the enemy half, Draw 1.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Blinding Flare
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Choose a row. This turn, enemy Runners in that row can't hit back.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Arc Flash
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Runner in the same lane as a friendly Runner you Infused this turn.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Relay Beacon
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Choose a friendly Runner. Until the end of your next turn, it has the Carrier trait (your Drones' Uplink is on).
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Rearm
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Return up to 2 Traps from your discard pile to your hand.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Fortify
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: When an enemy attacks a friendly Runner: that Runner gets Plating 2 against that attack (it deals 2 less damage).
supports.howto: Play it the moment its trigger happens, on either player's turn. Then discard it.

supports.name: Rift Step
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Move a friendly Runner to any empty square in its row. A trap on that square still goes off.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Remote Detonation
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Choose one of your face-down traps. It activates on an enemy Runner next to it (any direction), as if that Runner had entered its square.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Field Intel
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Recon 4. Put any number of those cards on the bottom of the deck and the rest back on top in any order. Draw 1.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Requisition
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Search your deck for a Runner that costs 3 or less, show it, and put it in your hand. Shuffle your deck.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Patch Up
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Restore 1 Health to a friendly Runner.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Smoke Screen
supports.title: Protocol
supports.text: Choose a friendly Runner. It can't be attacked until the start of your next turn.
supports.howto: Pay its cost, resolve it, then discard it.

supports.name: Overcharged Rounds
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: +2 ATK.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Hardened Frame
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: +2 Lethal on every step that has one. No effect on the last step.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Rift Striders
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: +1 MOV.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Emergency Stabilizer
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: The first time this Runner would be defeated, it drops to its last step instead. Then discard this upgrade.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Field Radio
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: When this Runner is defeated, Draw 2.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Medkit
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: Once per game, during your turn: this Runner restores 1 Health. Then discard this upgrade.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Recon Visor
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: When this Runner ends a move, you may look at one face-down enemy trap up to 2 squares ahead in its lane.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Halcyte Capacitor
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: This Runner can be Infused up to 3 times per turn.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Ward Banner
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: At the start of your turn, restore 1 Health to one friendly Runner beside this Runner.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Courier Pack
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: +1 MOV. When this Runner ends a move in the enemy half, Draw 1 (once per turn).
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Prism Focus
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: The first time you Infuse this Runner each turn, it gets +2 ATK instead of +1.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Uplink Module
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: This Runner has the Carrier trait.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Charge Bandolier
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: Once per turn, instead of attacking, place a Trap from your hand face-down on an empty square next to this Runner (any direction), in your half.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.

supports.name: Heavy Plating
supports.title: Upgrade
supports.text: Plating 1 (attacks on this Runner deal 1 less damage). It can't be pushed.
supports.howto: Attach to one of your Runners on the board. Max 1 upgrade per Runner.
